concept.title: NC State Cybersecurity
concept.shortdesc: This resource provides cybersecurity documentation and instructions to support members of the NC State community, including staff, faculty and students.

conbody.p: This resource outlines common cybersecurity topics, including phishing, password maintenance, two-factor authentication, network security, email, software licensing, data protection and more. NC State users can navigate this guide to find documentation and instructions for completing cybersecurity tasks, explanations of important cybersecurity concepts and reference information about university resources.
